adCopy.title: What GLP-1 Does to Your Drive
adCopy.body:
The weight's coming off.

But something else is going with it.

GLP-1 meds work. Nobody's arguing that.

But here's what your prescribing doctor didn't mention:

Rapid weight loss floods your system with cortisol.

Cortisol chokes the signal that keeps your energy steady. Your body burns lean tissue for fuel — instead of protecting it.

Your mornings get heavier.
Your afternoons disappear.
Your presence fades.

You're lighter on the scale — but foggier, flatter, and running on fumes.

That's not progress. That's a trade you didn't agree to.

Tenor Daily Drive Essentials was built to support what GLP-1s quietly drain:

💪 Tongkat Ali (400mg) — supports the stress response that rapid weight loss disrupts

💪 Zinc (50mg) — feeds the pathway your body needs to maintain healthy hormone levels

💪 21 active ingredients at disclosed doses — supporting drive, stamina, and recovery from every angle

No proprietary blends.
No hidden doses.
No guessing.

In a survey of 1,203 men, 94% reported sustained morning energy. 87% felt more focused and present. Results you can feel — backed by transparent dosing, not promises.

Save 52% on your first 90-day supply. 90-day empty-bottle guarantee.

See why men on GLP-1s are adding this two-capsule morning protocol to their daily routine.
